betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Device Info Terminal has no recipe — it is handed to you here, as the chapter's milestone.

Right-click any working GT machine to bind it; right-click air to open the ledger. Rows show tri-state (Running/Idle/Stopped), instant EU/t, a 60-point rolling average, position and the current recipe. Sort by any of five columns; the notation mode toggles like the monitors.

The row's sparkle button teleports you to the machine for XP levels, Ctrl+click unbinds remotely, and shift+right-click air runs a team-wide scan with a 20 second countdown. Placing a machine while carrying the terminal auto-binds it too.
